title: Check: Reactions of Acids with Metals (2) (B)

questions.stem: Which of these metals reacts most vigorously with dilute hydrochloric acid?
questions.explanation: Magnesium is the most reactive of these metals and reacts vigorously with dilute HCl, producing rapid bubbling and the metal disappearing quickly. Zinc reacts moderately, iron reacts slowly, and copper does not react at all as it is below hydrogen in the reactivity series.
